impact: Equipment editor changes only the numeric widget class; adopt held-step acceleration. Catalog, schema, source registry and fitting code are unchanged from the adopted equipment revision.

Studio filterCoefficients, filterResponseDb and StereoEqualizer::Biquad::process are byte-identical to the original DAW DSP reuse snapshot. Profile preparation now has an off-thread prepared structure, already provided by the DAW engine; retain DAW validation, events, arbitrary channels and unclamped headroom.
New equalizer enhancements and native Windows endpoint deployment plans do not change a reused DSP subset; they are not imported as DAW processors or a DAW audio backend.

At the committed-head refresh, all 24 registered inputs match retained reviewed bytes. New APO/native routing and ongoing guardian/virtual-driver work are outside the borrowed DSP/editor subset; no DAW backend or processor changes are justified by those additions.
upstream_candidates: Overflow-bounded scaled step multiplication; retain focused-only wheel behavior in editors.
